name: Architectural Awe
short_description: The experience of awe elicited by vast, complex, or sublime architectural spaces, involving self-diminishment, attentional broadening, and prosocial behavior shifts.

components.name: Vastness Perception
components.description: Perceived vastness of an architectural space (scale, height, openness) is the primary elicitor of architectural awe.

components.name: Small-Self Effect
components.description: Awe-inducing environments trigger a diminished sense of self, promoting humility and perspective-taking.

components.name: Attentional Broadening
components.description: Awe shifts attention from narrow, self-focused processing to broad, accommodative processing.

components.name: Dose-Response
components.description: Awe effects show a dose-response relationship with exposure duration and intensity.

design_implications: Use disproportionate vertical scale (high ceilings, tall atriums) to elicit vastness.
Employ complexity that requires accommodation — patterns too rich to be immediately grasped.
Design transitional compression-to-expansion sequences (low corridor → tall hall) to amplify the awe moment.
Consider cultural and individual differences in awe susceptibility when designing for diverse populations.

confidence_intervals.note: Effect sizes for architectural awe induction on self-reported emotion and prosocial behavior.
